name: Monroe County, IN
findings: Monroe County has 577 nonprofit organizations. 294 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 257 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Monroe County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
